
## Quarterly Secret Rotation — IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN

- [ ] Generate a **NEW** token in IBM Quantum dashboard.
- [ ] Run `./ops/rotate_ibm_token.sh` to update GitHub & Vercel.
- [ ] Revoke the **OLD** token in IBM.
- [ ] Confirm `IBM_TOKEN_ROTATED_AT` variable updated.
- [ ] Trigger **Quantum Pulse** workflow to validate.
